# CustomSkinLoader binary attribution

This directory contains the unmodified official `CustomSkinLoader_Universal-15.0.1.jar` release from `xfl03/MCCustomSkinLoader`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/xfl03/MCCustomSkinLoader
- Release: https://github.com/xfl03/MCCustomSkinLoader/releases/tag/v15.0.1
- SHA-256: `026D8B38EA93EDCCD647F60568193E79801A377B7BD4E916DCFC0D5482B767FC`
- License: GPL-3.0-only (see upstream repository)

The upstream README permits distributing the unmodified official binary in a modpack when the mod is listed. It is client-only and must not be installed on a dedicated server.
